status.description: Status is the current status of the SecretStore.

SecretStore.title: Secret Store
SecretStore.description: SecretStore represents the external key management system that holds the key encryption key (KEK) which the Cluster uses to wrap the data encryption keys (DEKs) that encrypt the Secrets at rest. The key itself never leaves the external system, therefore the Secrets cannot be decrypted without it.

azureKeyVault.description: AzureKeyVault sets the Azure Key Vault specific options.

hashicorpVault.description: HashicorpVault sets the HashiCorp Vault specific options.

googleCloudKeyManagementService.description: GoogleCloudKeyManagementService sets the Google Cloud KMS specific options.

awsKeyManagementService.description: AWSKeyManagementService sets the AWS KMS specific options.

kubernetes.description: Kubernetes sets the kubernetes Secret specific options.

keyID.description: KeyID is the ID or ARN of the KMS key that is used to wrap the data encryption keys. Required.

region.description: Region is the AWS region code of the key (e.g. `us-east-1`).

roleARN.description: RoleARN is the ARN of the IAM role that is assumed to access the key.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SecretSt.title: AWS Key Management Service
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SecretSt.description: AWSKeyManagementService sets the AWS KMS specific options

clientID.description: ClientID is the client ID of the Entra ID application that is used to access the vault. Required.

tenantID.description: TenantID is the ID of the Entra ID tenant that owns the application. Required.

vaultURL.description: VaultURL is the URL of the Key Vault (e.g. `https://myvault.vault.azure.net`). Required.

key.description: Key is the name of the Key Vault key that is used to wrap the data encryption keys. Required.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SecretSt.title: Azure Key Vault
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SecretSt.description: AzureKeyVault sets the Azure Key Vault specific options

project.description: Project is the GCP project name. Required.

location.description: Location is the GCP location of the key ring (e.g. `global`, `europe-west1`). Required.

keyRing.description: KeyRing is the name of the Cloud KMS key ring. Required.

key.description: Key is the name of the Cloud KMS key that is used to wrap the data encryption keys. Required.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SecretSt.title: Google Cloud Key Management Service
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SecretSt.description: GoogleCloudKeyManagementService sets the Google Cloud KMS specific options

address.description: Address is the URL of the Vault server (e.g. `https://vault.example.com:8200`). Required.

role.description: Role is the name of the Vault Kubernetes auth role that the Cluster logs in as. Required.

key.description: Key is the name of the Vault transit key that is used to wrap the data encryption keys. Required.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SecretSt.title: Hashicorp Vault
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SecretSt.description: HashicorpVault sets the HashiCorp Vault transit engine specific options

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SecretSt.title: Kubernetes
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SecretSt.description: Kubernetes stores the key encryption key in a kubernetes Secret of the Cluster itself. It is the default mode which requires no external key management system. It is not recommended in production environments.

type.title: Type
type.description: Type is the currently set type of the SecretStore. It is derived by the Cluster from the `type` field of the Spec.

state.title: State
state.description: State is the current state of the SecretStore.

synchronization.description: Synchronization is the currently ongoing or last requested synchronization.

lastSynchronizations.description: LastSynchronizations is the list of the most recent synchronizations.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SecretSt.title: Status
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SecretSt.description: Status is the current status of the SecretStore

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the date at which the synchronization was requested.

state.title: State
state.description: State is the current state of the synchronization.

completedAt.description: CompletedAt is the date at which the synchronization completed or failed.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SecretSt.title: Synchronization
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.SecretSt.description: Synchronization is the state of a re-wrapping of the Cluster's data encryption keys with the SecretStore's key encryption key

uid.description: UID is the unique UUID value for the object assigned by the Cluster. Read-only.

name.description: Name is the name of the object. It must be unique within a certain API/Version/Kind tuple.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the timestamp of creation of the object. Read-only.

updatedAt.description: UpdatedAt is the timestamp of when the object was last updated. Read-only.

displayName.description: DisplayName is the name that can be shown publicly for the object. Doesn't need to be unique.

description.description: Description is used to describe the object in a short sentence. Maximum characters are 1000.

labels.description: Labels is a map of string keys and values to organize objects.

tags.description: Tags is an optional array of tags that classify the Resource.

annotations.description: Annotations is a map of string keys and values that can be used to store arbitrary metadata about the object.

picURL.description: PicURL is the Picture URL of the resource.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is a unique ID that represent the current version of the resource object. Used by the Cluster to detect updates.

lastResourceVersion.description: LastResourceVersion is the ResourceVersion of the last update of the Resource.

actorRef.description: ActorRef is the object reference to the Actor resource, typically a Session, who is responsible for the current resource change. If ActorRef is not set, then the current change of the resource was done by the Cluster

actorOperation.description: ActorOperation is the gRPC full method triggered by the actorRef to modify the Resource

isSystem.description: IsSystem means that the resource is created by the Cluster and it cannot be managed by the administrators. Read-only.

specLabels.description: SpecLabels is map used internally by the Cluster for quick searches among lists of objects. Read-only.

isUserHidden.description: IsUserHidden means that the resource object is hidden from ordinary Users and should not be exposed via the User APIs.

isSystemHidden.description: IsSystemHidden means that the resource object is hidden by the Cluster and should not be exposed via the APIs.

systemLabels.description: SystemLabels is a similar map to specLabels. Used only by the Cluster.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Metadata.title: Metadata
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Metadata.description: Metadata is the metadata that is common to every Cluster resource. It carries the resource's identity (i.e. its UID and name), its human-readable information as well as the Cluster-managed bookkeeping of the resource's versioning and provenance.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion is the API version of the reference resource

kind.description: Kind is the resource kind. A kind is unique per an APIVersion.

uid.description: UID is the resource object UID. A UID is unique across the entire Cluster.

name.description: Name is the resource object name. A name is unique per a certain kind.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is the resourceVersion of the resource.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.title: Object Reference
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.description: ObjectReference is a reference to another Cluster resource. It identifies the referenced resource by its kind and either its UID or its name.
